claim_scope: Replay-safe adversarial audit of the authenticated frozen-control GitHub calibration layer only. No protected/fresh benchmark evidence, prospective scientific score, or runtime change was opened or measured.
runtime_implementation_implication: NONE. The findings harden transport/evidence admission only. MM06/BIL00 should not interpret GitHub CI PASS or worker self-attestation as sufficient schema/reread proof until the identified gaps are independently closed.
next_action: MM06 should independently validate this and every worker receipt against the frozen Draft 2020-12 schema, independently reread and bind the report blob/commit in verification, and quarantine any reliance on the frozen CI validator as proof of schema conformance. BIL00 should consider a control-plane repair before counting calibration if MM06 cannot fully compensate for these gaps.

negative_zero_outcomes.detail: Calibration and MF04 assignment both prohibit fresh work; no private manifest was fetched and fresh_evidence_ids is empty.
All 15 files named by the active control manifest reread with exactly the frozen Git blob identities.
The prompt-private MF04 capability material hashes to the public MF04 commitment and a cohort-bound HMAC proof was computed without exposing that material.
The connector exposed no combined status entries for the pre-write active main commit; this is not treated as PASS.
E1/G1/C1/E3 scientific uplift was not measured in this replay-only transport calibration role.

research_questions.question: What is the minimal deterministic Draft 2020-12 validation profile for immutable experiment-bus receipts that both executes the frozen schemas and enforces a closed-world public-safety property policy without relying on a finite blacklist of sensitive key names?
research_questions.parent_blocker_or_claim: T0 authenticated frozen-control calibration: schema/public-safety admission
research_questions.why_it_matters: The frozen CI validator performs custom field checks but does not execute the frozen JSON Schemas, while the report schema itself leaves undeclared properties open by default. A malformed or unexpected-field receipt can therefore survive one layer that is informally described as schema/public-safety validation.
research_questions.closure_criterion: Specify an executable, version-frozen validation method with negative tests proving missing required fields and undeclared public fields are rejected, while preserving the allowed role_payload extension surface intentionally rather than accidentally.

research_questions.question: How should create-once immutable receipts represent post-write reread and post-commit CI observations without requiring the receipt to self-assert an event that can only occur after the receipt is created?
research_questions.parent_blocker_or_claim: T0 create-once receipt provenance and calibration write+reread proof
research_questions.why_it_matters: The frozen worker schema requires git_reread_verified=true inside the create-once report, but the protocol performs the GitHub reread only after creation. Independent verifier-owned attestation may be needed to make the temporal ordering explicit and auditable.
research_questions.closure_criterion: Define a machine-checkable provenance pattern, such as verifier-owned blob/commit attestation or a separate immutable acknowledgement, whose truth can only be asserted after the observed Git event and which cannot be overwritten by the originating worker.

falsifiers.name: CI_SCHEMA_EXECUTION_GAP
falsifiers.observation: The frozen scripts/validate_bus.py never invokes a Draft 2020-12 schema validator. Its report loop checks a selected subset of identities, mode, CI enum, cost counters and calibration fresh-work rules.
falsifiers.negative_probe: A synthetic report object satisfying the frozen custom per-report checks while omitting eight fields required by schemas/report.schema.json produced zero custom-check errors; a Draft 2020-12 required-field validation rejects that same object.
falsifiers.bounded_conclusion: BUS VALIDATION PASS from the frozen script is not, by itself, evidence that a worker report conforms to the frozen report JSON Schema. MM06 can compensate only by independently executing the frozen schema validation.

falsifiers.name: OPEN_WORLD_REPORT_PROPERTY_GAP
falsifiers.observation: The frozen report schema does not set additionalProperties=false or an equivalent closed-world rule. Draft 2020-12 therefore permits undeclared properties by default. The public-safety validator rejects a finite set of key names and raw numbered test identifiers, not every undeclared field.
falsifiers.bounded_conclusion: Schema conformance alone cannot be treated as an allowlist proof for public fields. This does not demonstrate an actual protected-data leak; it demonstrates that the structural policy is open-world and depends on additional semantic review.

falsifiers.name: POSTWRITE_REREAD_SELF_ATTESTATION_GAP
falsifiers.observation: The frozen report schema requires git_reread_verified=true in the immutable file, while the frozen worker protocol creates the file first and rereads it second.
falsifiers.bounded_conclusion: The worker field is a completed-transaction assertion, not independent evidence of the post-write observation. The verifier must independently reread and record the observed Git blob/commit; otherwise the calibration write+reread claim is self-attested by the originator.

quarantine: Do not interpret the frozen CI validator's PASS as proof of report.schema.json conformance.
Do not interpret schema conformance as closed-world public-field safety while undeclared properties remain allowed.
Do not interpret git_reread_verified=true in an originating report as independent proof of its own post-write reread.

cost_ledger.notes: Replay-safe control-plane inspection, two local deterministic negative probes, one narrow official JSON Schema semantics check; no benchmark execution.
